figma._comment: Official Figma Remote MCP. Reads/writes text in Figma files. Requires Figma account with MCP beta enabled.

figma-export._comment: Exports PNG images from Figma. Get a PAT at https://www.figma.com/developers/api#access-tokens

x-twitter._comment: X/Twitter MCP from github.com/Infatoshi/x-mcp. Used for posting tweets and uploading media.
